title: Cursor Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Cursor is an excellent AI code editor, but it falls short on hosting, non-technical usability, and billing predictability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: For a developer who wants a faster editor, Cursor is genuinely strong at that one job. For anyone who needs a hosted, complete product, database, auth, payments, and a live URL, without writing code, Blink is the better alternative: it covers everything Cursor doesn't even attempt, hosting, a backend, no-code usability, and flat pricing. More options are ranked in our[Cursor alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/cursor-alternatives) roundup.
